```diff
+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import { CheckCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
+ 
+ interface SuccessRedirectProps {
+   isOpen: boolean;
+   title: string;
+   message: string;
+   redirectTo?: string;
+   redirectDelay?: number;
+ }
+ 
+ const SuccessRedirect: React.FC&lt;SuccessRedirectProps&gt; = ({
+   isOpen,
+   title,
+   message,
+   redirectTo = '/',
+   redirectDelay = 2000,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const router = useRouter();
+   const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(Math.ceil(redirectDelay / 1000));
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!isOpen) return;
+ 
+     // Countdown timer
+     const interval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+       setCountdown((prev) =&gt; {
+         if (prev &lt;= 1) {
+           clearInterval(interval);
+           return 0;
+         }
+         return prev - 1;
+       });
+     }, 1000);
+ 
+     // Redirect after delay
+     const timeout = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       router.push(redirectTo);
+     }, redirectDelay);
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       clearInterval(interval);
+       clearTimeout(timeout);
+     };
+   }, [isOpen, redirectTo, redirectDelay, router]);
+ 
+   if (!isOpen) return null;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-300"&gt;
+       {/* Backdrop */}
+       &lt;div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-maahi-brand/95 via-maahi-accent/95 to-teal-600/95 backdrop-blur-sm"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Success Card */}
+       &lt;div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-300 p-8 text-center"&gt;
+         {/* Success Icon */}
+         &lt;div className="flex justify-center mb-6"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="absolute inset-0 bg-green-500 rounded-full animate-ping opacity-75"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;div className="relative bg-green-100 rounded-full p-4"&gt;
+               &lt;CheckCircle className="w-16 h-16 text-green-600" /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Title */}
+         &lt;h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3"&gt;{title}&lt;/h2&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Message */}
+         &lt;p className="text-gray-600 text-base mb-6 leading-relaxed"&gt;{message}&lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Loading Indicator */}
+         &lt;div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3"&gt;
+           &lt;Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 text-maahi-brand animate-spin" /&gt;
+           &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500"&gt;
+             Redirecting in {countdown} second{countdown !== 1 ? 's' : ''}...
+           &lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default SuccessRedirect;
+ 
```

## Changes Made:

1. **Created `SuccessRedirect` component** (`src/components/SuccessRedirect.tsx`):
   - Success screen with animated checkmark icon
   - Countdown timer showing redirect progress
   - Auto-redirects after 2 seconds
   - Gradient backdrop

2. **Updated onboarding page** (`src/app/onboarding/page.tsx`):
   - Removed all `alert()` calls
   - Added state management for success and error notifications
   - Shows `SuccessRedirect` on successful login/registration
   - Shows `NotificationModal` for errors (configuration, authentication, etc.)
   - Cleaned up unused imports

## Features:

- No system alerts — all notifications are in-app
- Lightweight — no external toast libraries
- Better UX — success screen with auto-redirect
- Error handling — errors shown in styled modals
- Responsive — works on mobile and desktop

After login or registration, users see a success screen that automatically redirects to the home page. Errors are shown in styled modals instead of browser alerts.

---


The `/diagnostics` page is used in the app.

## How it's used

1. Linked from `EnvWarningBanner` — when environment variables aren't configured, a warning banner appears with a "Check Setup" button that links to `/diagnostics`.
2. Referenced in documentation — mentioned in `SETUP.md`, `QUICKSTART.md`, `TROUBLESHOOTING.md`, and `README.md` as a way to verify configuration.
3. Development utility — checks:
   - Supabase URL configuration
   - Supabase Anon Key
   - Supabase connection status
   - MapTiler API Key

## Difference from `/map-test`

- `/diagnostics` — integrated into the app (linked from warning banner)
- `/map-test` — standalone test page with no references

Recommendation: keep `/diagnostics` since it's integrated and useful for troubleshooting. You can remove `/map-test` if you don't need it, or merge its functionality into `/diagnostics` if you want a single diagnostics page.

## Changes Made:

1. **Added highlight prop to LocationSearch component**:
   - Added `highlight` prop to enable visual highlighting
   - When highlighted: pulsing border, glow effect, and ring animation

2. **Added state management in main page**:
   - Added `highlightDropoff` state to track when to highlight
   - Highlights automatically when pickup is confirmed
   - Auto-removes after 5 seconds

3. **Visual effects on drop-off field**:
   - Pulsing border animation
   - Glow effect with brand color
   - Ring animation for attention

4. **Hint message**:
   - Shows below the drop-off field when pickup is locked but drop-off isn't selected
   - Message: "Great! Now select your drop-off location"
   - Fade-in animation

5. **Smart behavior**:
   - Highlight stops when user selects a drop-off location
   - Highlight reappears if user clears the drop-off (for 5 seconds)
   - Only shows when pickup is locked and drop-off is empty

After confirming the pickup location, users will see:
- The drop-off field pulsing with a glow effect
- A hint message below guiding them to select the drop-off location
- The highlight automatically fades after 5 seconds or when they start interacting

This provides clear visual guidance without being intrusive.

## Changes Made:

1. **Updated the `onClear` handler** for the destination field:
   - When the destination is cleared, if `mapCenter` exists (map pin is visible), it:
     - Generates a DigiPin from the current map center position
     - Sets `tempDestination` to the current map center coordinates
     - Sets `isAdjustingDestination` to `true`
   - This makes the "Confirm Destination" button reappear

2. **Button behavior**:
   - The "Confirm Destination" button (lines 775-790) shows when `pickupLocked && isAdjustingDestination`
   - After clearing, if the map pin is visible, `isAdjustingDestination` becomes `true`, so the button appears
   - Clicking the button confirms the destination at the current map pin position

**Flow:**
1. User confirms pickup → pickup locked
2. User selects destination → adjusts pin → confirms → booking sheet opens
3. User clears destination → if map pin is visible, "Confirm Destination" button reappears
4. User can confirm the destination at the current pin position or search for a new one

This keeps the map pin visible and allows confirming it after clearing the destination.

```diff
+   // Unlock pickup location and reset booking state
+   const handleUnlockPickup = () =&gt; {
+     // Unlock pickup
+     unlockPickup();
+     
+     // Clear pickup
+     setPickup(null);
+     setTempPickupDigipin('');
+     
+     // Clear destination and related state
+     setDrop(null);
+     setTempDestination(null);
+     setIsAdjustingDestination(false);
+     setDistance(null);
+     setRouteGeometry(null);
+     setHighlightDropoff(false);
+     
+     // Close booking sheet if open
+     setIsBookingSheetOpen(false);
+     setSelectedDate('');
+     setSelectedTime('');
+     setSelectedAmPm('AM');
+     
+     // Fly back to pickup location if it exists, otherwise keep current view
+     if (pickup &amp;&amp; mapInstanceRef.current) {
+       mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo([pickup.latitude, pickup.longitude], 16, {
+         duration: 1.5,
+         easeLinearity: 0.25
+       });
+     }
+     
+     console.log('Pickup location unlocked - user can now edit');
+   };
```

## Changes Made:

1. **Added Edit icon**: Imported `Edit2` from `lucide-react`.

2. **Created `handleUnlockPickup` function**:
   - Unlocks the pickup location
   - Clears pickup and destination
   - Resets related state (distance, route, booking sheet, etc.)
   - Flies the map back to the pickup location if it exists

3. **Added Edit button**:
   - When pickup is locked, shows an edit button (pencil icon) instead of the location button
   - Clicking it unlocks the pickup and allows editing
   - Uses the brand color to match the UI

4. **Updated clear handler**: The X button on the pickup field also uses `handleUnlockPickup` for consistency.

**User flow:**
- After confirming pickup, an edit button appears next to the pickup field
- Clicking it unlocks the pickup, clears the destination, and resets booking state
- The user can then change the pickup location without reloading the page
- The map flies back to the original pickup location for reference

This allows users to change the pickup location at any time without reloading.

## Changes Made:

1. **Added state for saved addresses**: Track Home and Work addresses separately.

2. **Created `fetchSavedAddresses` function**:
   - Fetches addresses from `user_addresses` table
   - Filters for 'home' and 'work' types
   - Stores them in state

3. **Fetch addresses on login**: Called when user logs in or auth state changes.

4. **Added quick-select buttons**:
   - Appear above the destination search field when pickup is locked
   - Show Home and/or Work buttons if addresses exist
   - Styled to match the UI with icons

5. **Button functionality**:
   - On click, creates a destination object using saved address data:
     - `latitude` and `longitude` from saved address
     - `digipin` from saved address
     - `address` formatted from `house_road_name` and `locality`
     - Other fields (locality, pincode, district, state)
   - Flies map to the selected address
   - Sets destination for adjustment/confirmation

6. **Refresh on pickup lock**: Refreshes saved addresses when pickup is confirmed to ensure latest data.

**User Experience:**
- After confirming pickup, if the user has saved Home/Work addresses, quick-select buttons appear
- One click selects the saved address as destination
- Uses existing DigiPin and coordinates from the database
- Map automatically flies to the selected location

This provides quick access to frequently used destinations.

Moved the Home and Work buttons below the destination search field and updated the design to match the reference.

## Changes Made:

1. **Moved buttons below destination search**: They appear directly under the destination LocationSearch field.

2. **Updated design to match reference**:
   - Full-width clickable items (not side-by-side buttons)
   - Circular icon backgrounds (light blue) with Home/Work icons
   - Bold label ("Home" or "Work")
   - Truncated address text below the label
   - Card-style with shadow and hover effects

3. **Improved layout**:
   - Spacing between buttons (`space-y-1`)
   - Proper truncation for long addresses
   - Hover and active states

4. **Conditional display**:
   - Only shows when pickup is locked
   - Only shows when user has saved Home/Work addresses
   - Hint message only shows if no saved addresses exist

The buttons now appear below the destination search field, matching the reference design with icons, labels, and addresses.
